text: Ada opened the gate. "Come inside," Ada said. Bruno smiled. "Thank you," Bruno replied.
Miriam put down her cup. "I will return tomorrow," she said.
🌙 Élodie watched the sky. "It is late," Élodie said.
The hallway was dark. "Is anyone there?" The wind rattled the door.
Ada looked at Bruno. "Clara told me the news," Ada said. "I already know," Bruno replied.
Eleanor stopped by the window. "Wait here. I will bring the letter," Eleanor said.
